diagnosed: REAL, recurring breakage — every ESCALATION of the research agent fails. Pattern is clean-cut: all `schedule`-triggered research runs succeed; all `workflow_dispatch`-triggered runs fail (e.g. run 30335112817 2026-07-28T06:31, run 30308235522 2026-07-27T21:46). The failure is `##[error]Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use '*' to allow all bots.` Root cause: scout / coverage-critic escalate research via `scripts/escalate-research.js` -> `gh workflow run research-agent.yml` using the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (they deliberately use the default token because it carries actions:write, unlike the agent's OIDC app token — see scout-agent.yml comment / WP-91). A GITHUB_TOKEN dispatch runs with actor `github-actions[bot]`, and `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` blocks bot actors unless allow-listed. research-agent.yml sets no `allowed_bots` on any of its three claude-code-action steps, so 100% of escalations die on arrival — the scout/coverage-critic -> research escalation loop (a core coverage feature) is entirely non-functional.
notes: FIX IS HUMAN-REQUIRED (protected path). The correct, minimal root-cause fix is to add `allowed_bots: github-actions` to the `with:` block of each `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` step in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml (the standard-tier step ~line 79, the deep Fable-5 step ~line 102, and the deep Opus-fallback step ~line 130). Scope to `github-actions`, NOT '*': only this repo's own workflows can dispatch research (workflow_dispatch requires repo write), and the action's own docs warn '*' lets external Apps invoke it on a public repo.

Value verified against the action source: claude-code-action lowercases the actor and strips the `[bot]` suffix before comparing (actor.toLowerCase().replace to drop a trailing [bot]), so `allowed_bots: github-actions` correctly matches the `github-actions[bot]` dispatch actor. The action README example confirms `allowed_bots: github-actions`.

I could not author this fix: .github/workflows/** is a protected automation path and the CI-only protect-automation hook (scripts/hooks/protect-automation.js) BLOCKS any unattended agent from writing it — 'a protected-path change must be authored by a human, not any unattended agent.' The hook fired on the Edit attempt; the branch was left clean and no PR was opened. This supersedes self-repair.md's older 'still make it, it'll wait for review' prose.

No non-protected alternative fix exists: the escalation is inherently bot-triggered (any GITHUB_TOKEN dispatch -> github-actions[bot]); the only other route (a human-actor PAT with actions:write, as escalate-research.js's own failure-issue text suggests) needs a new secret AND still edits the protected scout/coverage-critic escalate steps. The workflow allowed_bots line is the smallest correct fix.
Not the governor's job: usage-state.json is green (session 40%, week 12%, skipAll/skipNiceToHave false) — these are not quota skips, they are hard rejections of every escalation.

Everything else is healthy: `npm test` 1207 passing, `node scripts/validate-events.js` clean (0 errors; only pre-existing non-fatal chess-timezone + one streaming-missing warning), entities.json fresh-rebuild byte-identical.
